purpose: Held-out check for a rule that separates a question's source description (e.g. '2006년 신문 연재 기사에서는') from its content. The rule was designed from docs-v2-097/103/104/106 and holdout-v1-037; these 16 questions were written before the rule and are not used to choose it.
gold_rule: Parents holding every requirement phrase and published in the named source year (build_holdout_queries.py source_year).
limitations: Questions and labels were written by the assistant from the target chunk only; human review is pending.
The author already knew the failure pattern being targeted, so the wording style may lean toward it. Sampling of documents and target chunks was seeded and blind to search.
Several target chunks are English EAR text, name lists or blank forms; they were kept rather than replaced.
Not committed to git at freeze time; the manifest hashes are the record.
use: Kept as a record only (user decision 2026-09-29). Not a benchmark for choosing settings; do not tune against it.

searched.engine: title^1 + multi-index DFS + undated-document period boost (weight 4), judges off, k=5, core+docs

misses.source-ref-v1-001: English EAR text vs Korean question
misses.source-ref-v1-004: English EAR text vs Korean question
misses.source-ref-v1-014: the post is returned instead of its attachment that holds the answer
